window: The entry is read 15 minutes after the open (09:45 on a full day).
The exit is read 15 minutes before the close (15:45 on a full day).
On a day that closes early both times keep their distance from the open and the close, and a day they no longer fit is skipped.
An order fills at the next minute's opening trade, never at the minute or the price that set it off.
A buy is dropped if its contract does not trade in that minute; a sale is tried each minute until it does.
At the exit, whatever is open is sold, legs still waiting are cancelled and nothing more is bought.

sentences: Leg put_atm: buys 1 at-the-money put expiring on the trading date itself.
The buy waits until a minute closes at least 25% above where its premium stood at the entry time.

square_off: Square off is partial: a stop closes only the leg that was stopped.
costs: Each fill is moved 0.3% against you, then rounded against you to $0.01.
